title: 第4章 药铺断供第3章 凡骨试剑
lines: 沈照夜走出问剑碑广场时，第一口血还是没压住。
那些刚才看着问剑碑裂出“凡骨”的人，此刻都隔着几步看他。没人再笑，也没人上前。
沈霜终于从石柱后跑出来。
声音轻得像怕一喊大，沈照夜就会倒下去。
她跑到他面前，想替他按住肩伤。
沈霜怔了一下：“可是你的伤……”
青瓦檐下挂着晒干的苦藤，风一吹，藤枝碰在一起，发出细碎声。
药铺管事坐在柜台后，算盘摆在面前，旁边放着摊开的欠账册。
他看见沈照夜进门，只抬了一下眼。
沈照夜说：“先拿今日的药。”
“资格是资格，账是账。”管事把欠账册转过来，“沈霜，寒露丹三十二副，温脉散四十七帖，旧账二十三两七钱。今日再拿药，先结一半。”
不知道已经欠到这个数。
对外院弟子来说，不过是两瓶剑药。
对他来说，是三年杂役工钱也攒不出来的数。
管事摇头：“药铺不认夜工抵账。”
“以前你有杂役名额，有沈长庚旧名，还有韩执事批条。”
content_en:
When Shen Zhaoye walked out of Wenjianbei Square, he still couldn't hold back the first blood.
The crowd hasn't dispersed yet.
Those who had just watched the "mortal bones" crack out of the Wenjian Monument were now looking at him from a few steps away. No one smiled anymore, and no one came forward.
Shen Shuang finally ran out from behind the stone pillar.
"Brother."
The voice was so soft that Shen Zhaoye would fall down if he shouted loudly.
She ran to him and tried to hold down his shoulder injury.
Shen Zhaoye didn't let her press it.
Han Song is still watching.
Pei Lie is still watching.
He whispered: "Go to the pharmacy first."
Shen Shuang was stunned for a moment: "But your injury..."
"The medicine is important."
The drug store is on the east side of the front yard.
Dried vines hang under the eaves of the green tiles. When the wind blows, the branches of the vines touch together and make a tiny crackling sound.
The medicine cabinet is closed.
The manager of the drug store sat behind the counter, with an abacus in front of him and an open account book next to him.
When he saw Shen Zhaoye entering the door, he only raised his eyes.
"Come to pay?"
Shen Shuang's fingers tightened suddenly.
Shen Zhaoye said: "Take today's medicine first."
The steward made some calculations.
"There is no medicine for today."
"I have regained the qualification to ask the sword."
"Qualifications are qualifications, accounts are accounts." The steward turned over the debt book, "Shen Shuang, thirty-two pairs of Cold Dew Pills, forty-seven pieces of Wenmai Powder, twenty-three taels and seven old accounts. I will get half of the medicine today."
Shen Shuang's face turned pale.
She used to only know debts.
I didn’t know I already owed this amount.
Shen Zhaoye looked at the account book.
Twenty-three taels and seven cents.
To the disciples in the outer courtyard, they were just two bottles of sword medicine.
For him, it was more than he could save as a handyman in three years.
"I can take night jobs."
The manager shook his head: "The drug store doesn't accept night work as credit."
"I knew it before."
"In the past, you had a quota for handymen, the old name of Shen Changgeng, and the approval slip from Deacon Han."
The steward closed the account book.
title_en: Chapter 4 The Medicine Shop Cuts Off the Contribution Chapter 3 Testing the Sword with Mortal Bones
